issue_context.title: Add review on a migrated pull request will be considered as author
issue_context.body: After I migrated some repository(includes git data/wiki/pull requests/issues), then when I want to add some review on some PR which was not created by me. But the review system think it's me because it didn't read the original_author on issue table.

review_comments: Just to confirm from what I have understand when migrating if the user exist OriginalAuthorID  is not and set and issue.PosterID is not the doer (like it is by default) but found user ?
If OriginalAuthorID > 0, PosterID means migrator but not poster id. `OriginalAuthorID` is an external system id not gitea user id.
